GET /api/products.description: Products in stock in one UK size, or for bras one band (optionally one cup), optionally in one category (clothes, swimwear, activewear, lingerie) or one Clothes type (dresses, tops, knitwear, coats, jeans, trousers, skirts, jumpsuits, nightwear; spec 0005). With no size, Products in stock in at least one plus size (UK 18+ or band 38+), with size_label and fits null. Results come in the saved product order (rebuilt nightly), up to 500. Every result has clothes_type (null outside Clothes) and in_stock_sizes: its in-stock plus Size labels, UK sizes ascending, then bands and cups
queries: type (optional: a Clothes type; only with no category or category=clothes)
ids (a Saved page: up to 100 Product ids, comma-separated, on their own; sold out ones included, each with in_stock_uk_sizes)

GET /api/products/:product_id.description: One shoppable Product with all its Size labels; 404 if it is excluded, unsettled, missing or its Retailer removed

POST /api/click-outs.description: Live check, then { outcome: 'sent', url } or { outcome: 'sold_out', message, similar }

DELETE /api/retailers/:retailer_id.description: Remove a Retailer; its Products leave search at once

GET /api/review.description: The Review list: unsettled Size labels, Products and Suggested Retailers
